title: DALL·E: Introducing outpainting
snippet: Extend creativity and tell a bigger story with DALL·E images of any size.

title: Our approach to alignment research
snippet: We are improving our AI systems’ ability to learn from human feedback and to assist humans at evaluating AI. Our goal is to build a sufficiently aligned AI system that can help us solve all other alignment problems.

title: New and improved content moderation tooling
snippet: We are introducing a new and improved content moderation tool. The Moderation endpoint improves upon our previous content filter, and is available for free today to OpenAI API developers.
